arxiv-1801-06786.title: Weak Convergence Of Branched Conformal Immersions With Uniformly Bounded Areas And Willmore Energies
arxiv-1801-06786.creator: Guodong Wei
arxiv-1801-06786.description: Abstract . In this paper, we firstly extend Theorem 5.1.1 in [ 9 ] due to Hélein to a rescaled branched conformal immersed sequence(c.f. Theorem 1.5). By virtue of this local convergence theorem, we study the blowup behavior of a sequence of branched conformal immersions of closed Riemannian surface in ℝ n \mathbb{R}^{n} with uniformly bounded areas and Willmore energies.

arxiv-2109-00537.title: ASVspoof 2021: accelerating progress in spoofed and deepfake speech detection
arxiv-2109-00537.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by . ASVspoof 2021 is the fourth edition in the series of bi-annual challenges which aim to promote the study of spoofing and the design of countermeasures to protect automatic speaker verification systems from manipulation. In addition to a continued focus upon logical and physical access tasks in which there are a number of advances compared to previous editions, ASVspoof 2021 introduces a new task involving deepfake speech detection.

arxiv-2212-03328.title: Slicing all Edges of an n n -cube Requires n 2 / 3 n^{2/3} Hyperplanes
arxiv-2212-03328.creator: Ohad Klein
arxiv-2212-03328.description: Abstract Consider the n n -cube graph with vertices { − 1 , 1 } n \left\{-1,1\right\}^{n} and edges connecting vertices with hamming distance 1 1 . How many hyperplanes in ℝ n \mathbb{R}^{n} are needed in order to dissect all edges?

arxiv-2301-09107.title: A ‘moment-conserving’ reformulation of GW theory
arxiv-2301-09107.creator: Charles J. C. Scott, Oliver J. Backhouse, George H. Booth
arxiv-2301-09107.description: Abstract We show how to construct an effective Hamiltonian whose dimension scales linearly with system size, and whose eigenvalues systematically approximate the excitation energies of G ​ W GW theory. This is achieved by rigorously expanding the self-energy in order to exactly conserve a desired number of frequency-independent moments of the self-energy dynamics.

arxiv-2401-16269.title: Dual-adatom diffusion-limited growth model for compound nanowires: Application to InAs nanowires
arxiv-2401-16269.creator: Danylo Mosiiets, Yann Genuist, Joël Cibert, Edith Bellet-Amalric, Moïra Hocevar
arxiv-2401-16269.description: Abstract We propose a dual-adatom diffusion-limited model for the growth of compound semiconductor nanowires via the vapor-liquid-solid or the vapour-solid-solid mechanisms. The growth is catalyzed either by a liquid or a solid nanoparticle. We validate the model using experimental data from the growth of InAs nanowires catalyzed by a gold nanoparticle in a molecular beam epitaxy reactor.

arxiv-2406-17184.title: Minimax Optimality in Contextual Dynamic Pricing with General Valuation Models
arxiv-2406-17184.creator: Xueping Gong, Jiheng Zhang
arxiv-2406-17184.description: Abstract Dynamic pricing, the practice of adjusting prices based on contextual factors, has gained significant attention due to its impact on revenue maximization. In this paper, we address the contextual dynamic pricing problem, which involves pricing decisions based on observable product features and customer characteristics.

arxiv-2407-05388.title: Forest2Seq : Revitalizing Order Prior for Sequential Indoor Scene Synthesis
arxiv-2407-05388.creator: Qi Sun, Hang Zhou *, Wengang Zhou, Li Li, Houqiang Li
arxiv-2407-05388.description: Abstract Synthesizing realistic 3D indoor scenes is a challenging task that traditionally relies on manual arrangement and annotation by expert designers. Recent advances in autoregressive models have automated this process, but they often lack semantic understanding of the relationships and hierarchies present in real-world scenes, yielding limited performance.

arxiv-2505-11742.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sean R. Wilkinson, Patrick Widener. High Performance Computing (HPC) centers provide resources to users who require greater scale to “get science done”. They deploy infrastructure with singular hardware architectures, cutting-edge software environments, and stricter security measures as compared with users’ own resources. As a result, users often create and configure digital artifacts in ways that are specialized for the unique infrastructure at a given HPC center.

pmc-11653963.title: Letalidad por dengue y desigualdades en la Región de las Américas entre el 2014 y el 2023
pmc-11653963.creator: Miguel Gallego-Munuera, Manuel Colomé-Hidalgo
pmc-11653963.description: RESUMENObjetivo.Evaluar las diferencias en la letalidad del dengue entre las distintas subregiones de las Américas en el período 2014-2023 y explorar su relación con el índice de desarrollo humano (IDH) de cada región.Método.Estudio ecológico longitudinal realizado a partir de datos de acceso libre de cada país, que se agruparon en las subregiones correspondientes para calcular los distintos indicadores.

pmc-13068763.description: Despite advances in pharmacotherapy, many patients with inflammatory arthritis (IA) experience residual pain even in remission.
